description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Magic Princess], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)] and [Forest Protector Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Magic Princess
description.text: Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities don't consume uses, Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Lightning/Wind/Water ability

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Forest Protector Mode
description.text: Casts Guiding Break after another ally casts a Ice, Lightning, Wind or Water ability, removed after triggering three times, grants [Instant Cast 2] and [Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability +30% Boost 2] when removed

description.name: Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability +30% Boost 2
description.text: Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Guiding Break
description.text: Three single attacks (4.02 each), grants [Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to the ally who triggered this ability

description.name: Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability +30% Boost 1
description.text: Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities deal 30% more damage
